scripts.format: dprint fmt && uv run --locked --managed-python ruff format
scripts.check: dprint check && oxlint && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json && bun test && uv run --locked --managed-python ruff check && uv run --locked --managed-python ruff format --check && uv run --locked --managed-python ty check && uv run --locked --managed-python python -m unittest discover -s tests
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run build && bun run test:browser
scripts.refresh: uv run --locked --managed-python python -m scripts.refresh && bun run data
